control.role: Unchanged e107 as direct baseline, not main89

harness.reason: Existing entry/harness hard-pin e107 versus main89. Do not dispatch them as a prototype comparison or dispatch the prototype tag legacy job. A new guarded control/harness must be implemented, fixed and reviewed first; no new workflow code is added this round.

environment: One existing free standard public xcode-27 arm64 allocation; verify actual macOS27/Xcode27/SDK27 and resource class. contents: read, independent non-cancelling concurrency, no PVT.
budgets: Retain reviewed 15min preparation, 90min diagnostic and 110/120min step/job bounds. On timeout/failure keep partial receipts and stop for diagnosis, no blind rerun or budget relaxation.
preparation: Separate pinned clean/object-independent checkouts; verify complete working bytes before loading reviewed code.

Fresh isolated release Cargo targets per CLI and fresh shared adapter scratch; do not reuse old binaries. Adapter source is unchanged: build once from e107 and use its exact single hash for both arms.
Record actual CLI/adapter hashes, commands/environment/toolchain, feature graphs with only checkout paths normalized, CPU/load/memory and source checks. Refuse graph/architecture drift.
Run the frozen-oracle HDR tests on arm64 in debug/release before measuring; Linux evidence does not prove Mac float behavior.

fixture.policy: Use the existing versioned benchmark in runner-local paths; do not upload source/output media or portraits. Check original hash before/after.

measurements: One warmup per arm plus five measured conversions per arm in the accepted ABBA order (12 total). XDREMUX_STYLES_PROFILE unset for primary E2E/CPU/RSS samples; no system-gain-map override.
Use the same fixed adapter, input bytes, working/path policy and CLI options. Independently validate every output outside timing and verify its recorded hash did not change.
After primary timing, at most one separate XDREMUX_STYLES_PROFILE=1 conversion per arm with the same validation. These two locator profiles are not timing medians or a formal budget.
Report all per-sample rows, variance and E2E/user/sys/RSS medians. Compare source-equivalent runtime stages, never add nested spans or sum stage medians as E2E attribution.
decision: No speed claim from source shape or Linux tests. If new same-host measurements do not demonstrate gain, discard as a performance fix; no approximation, lower precision, weaker validation, reduced local key1 semantics or larger unrelated rewrite.
formal_gates: e107 stays18green/2red with all past budget/ABBA failures preserved. A diagnostic never replaces final exact-head/native/App/Tone/SystemHEIF/absolute-performance acceptance.
artifacts: Owned explicit UTF-8 text whitelist only; receipts, hashes, logs, feature graph. No clones, binaries, image/video/raw pixels, full environment or secrets. Preserve failed/partial attempts.
